[Trend Position]

· Significant drop compared to SMA100 (120,358 KRW)/SMA200 (113,089 KRW): Long-term trend weakening.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.9→39.3): Entering oversold territory, downward momentum strengthening.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-359.6096→916.1712): Improvement starting after a death cross, in a weak convergence phase.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 76,606 KRW): Bandwidth is relatively wide at 59.56%, trading sideways near the mid-band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (68,045 KRW): Support level higher than Pivot S1 (49,953 KRW).
· Swing resistance (80,380 KRW): Potential for short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Potential Higher Low formation): Pattern of higher lows, possibility of a recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.47x): Increased volume for recent movements, slight increase in reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): High probability of continued sideways and accumulation phase due to RSI oversold, MACD improvement start, and ADX trend weakening. Observation around 70,500 KRW is needed pending further indicator confirmation.
